answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 42256 Country: Pakistan Title: Can we take milk if source is not known (which animal is used) will it be halal Question: Can we take milk if source is not known (which animal is used) will it be halal? Answer ID: 42256 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2134/1697/B=1433) If it is known with authentic resources that it is the milk of halal animal and it has come from lawful sources then it may be taken in without any doubt. But if there is a doubt whether it is halal or haram then one should avoid it and should not drink it. دع ما يريبك الی ما لا يريبك . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
